azanResponse.title: Respond to the Azan
azanResponse.subtitle: Hisnul Muslim — Du'aa at the Time of the Azan
azanResponse.instructionEnglish: Repeat each phrase after the mu'adhin. For “Hayya 'ala-s-Salah” (come to prayer) and “Hayya 'ala-l-Falah” (come to success), say this instead:
azanResponse.instructionOromo: Jecha mu'adhinichaa hunda deebisaa. “Hayya 'ala-s-Salah” fi “Hayya 'ala-l-Falah” irratti garuu kana jedhaa:
azanResponse.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللهِ
azanResponse.english: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
azanResponse.oromo: Tooftaafi humni Rabbiin biraa malee hin argamu.

azanDua.title: Du'aa After Azan
azanDua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
azanDua.english: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer, grant Muhammad the intercession and favour, and raise him to the honoured station You have promised him.
azanDua.oromo: Yaa Rabbi, Gooftaa waamicha (azaanaa) guutuu kanaafi salaata dhaabbataa kanaa, Muhammad (SAW) araarsaafi ol'aantummaa isaaf kenni; sadarkaa faarfamaa ati waadaa isaaf galte sanas isa gahi.
